findings.body: Because `transport` is unexported and no constructor or setter is provided, callers outside package `fetch` cannot create a usable `Framework`; the only constructible zero value panics when `Fetch` dereferences its nil transport. The new test misses this because it invokes the legacy package-level `Fetch` function rather than `Framework.Fetch`. Export the dependency field or add a constructor.
findings.title: Make Framework constructible by external callers
